claim_review_2026.primary_title: A counterexample to Vaught's Conjecture for L_{omega_1,omega}
claim_review_2026.claimed_theorem: A sentence of infinitary L_{omega_1,omega} has exactly aleph_1 countable models (and no perfect set of non-isomorphic models).
claim_review_2026.scope_note: M098 asks about complete first-order theories in a countable language, not infinitary L_{omega_1,omega} sentences. This manuscript does NOT refute or solve M098.
claim_review_2026.known_caveats: The pinned Lean development proves a thin aleph-1 spectrum for its own infinitary sentence, baseLanguage.densitySentence. The authors say this is not the first-order Vaught conjecture, that the formalization does not cover every claim of the manuscript, and that it does not identify those models with the manuscript's strongly coded templates. Knight's 2002 first-order announcement was not accepted.
claim_review_2026.next_review: Keep M098 verified_open. Record further first-order progress in research/M098_VAUGHT.md. A later revision of the infinitary formalization is not a resolution of this ID.
